name: Network Health Sweep
description: A normalized device and network health sweep across whatever network-monitoring tools (Auvik, Meraki, Domotz) are connected: each vendor family's data model and native status fields mapped into one Down/Degraded/Unknown/Healthy taxonomy, default interface error and utilization thresholds, topology-change detection, and why an offline Domotz collector renders its devices "unknown" rather than "down".
